presentationProfile.title: Supermemory
presentationProfile.description: Store, manage, search, and recall long-term contextual memories, user profiles, and documents with Supermemory

deleteV3ConnectionsByConnectionId.description: Delete a specific connection by ID

deleteV3ConnectionsByProvider.description: Deletes an integration connection and optionally removes imported documents

deleteV3ContainerTagsByContainerTag.description: Deletes a container tag along with all linked documents and memories

deleteV3DocumentsBulk.description: Deletes multiple documents simultaneously by a list of document IDs.

deleteV3DocumentsById.description: Permanently deletes a specific document by its unique ID or custom ID.

deleteV4Memories.description: Soft-deletes a specific memory entry by marking it as forgotten

getV3ConnectionsByConnectionIdResources.description: Fetch resources for a connection (supported providers: GitHub for now)

getV3ContainerTagsByContainerTag.description: Retrieves settings, display name, entity context prompt, and profile buckets for a container tag

getV3ContainerTagsList.description: Lists all spaces and container tags with document counts, memory counts, and activity dates

getV3ContainerTagsMergeByMergeId.description: Retrieves the execution progress and state of an active container tag merge job

getV3DocumentsById.description: Retrieves full details, metadata, status, and extracted memories for a specific document

getV3DocumentsByIdChunks.description: Retrieves the ordered text and image chunks extracted from a specific document

getV3DocumentsByIdFileUrl.description: Generates a temporary presigned download URL for a document's uploaded source file

getV3DocumentsProcessing.description: Retrieves in-flight, queued, or failed documents currently going through extraction

patchV3ContainerTagsByContainerTag.description: Updates the display name, custom entity context prompt, or bucket definitions of a container tag

patchV3DocumentsById.description: Updates the content, metadata, or container configuration of an existing document

patchV3SettingsSecurity.description: Sets whether two-factor authentication is required for the organization.

patchV4Memories.description: Creates a new version of an existing memory entry while preserving change history

postV3ConnectionsByConnectionIdConfigure.description: Configure resources for a connection (supported providers: GitHub for now)

postV3ConnectionsByProvider.description: Initializes an external integration connection and generates an authorization redirect URL

postV3ConnectionsByProviderConnection.description: Retrieves connection details by provider type and container tag filter

postV3ConnectionsByProviderDocuments.description: Lists all documents indexed from a specific integration provider and container tags

postV3ConnectionsByProviderImport.description: Triggers a manual background sync to import documents from a connected provider

postV3ConnectionsList.description: Lists external service integration connections filtered by container tags

postV3ContainerTagsMerge.description: Queues a background job to merge two container tags and consolidate their data into a target tag

postV3Documents.description: Ingests and processes content, URLs, or text into a containerized document

postV3DocumentsBatch.description: Ingests up to 600 documents in a single request with metadata and container scoping

postV3DocumentsFile.description: Uploads and processes a local binary file (PDF, text, image, or media) into a document

postV3DocumentsList.description: Retrieves a paginated list of documents filtered by container tags, metadata, or dates

postV3SettingsReset.description: Reset organization content: removes documents, memories, spaces (except default project), connections, and org settings. Preserves the org, members, and billing.

postV3SettingsSuggestBuckets.description: Suggest profile bucket definitions based on the organization context prompt. Returns 3–6 bucket suggestions tailored to the use-case described in the prompt.

postV4Conversations.description: Ingests or updates structured multi-turn conversation messages under a conversation ID.

postV4Memories.description: Creates entity-centric memories directly into vector storage, bypassing document extraction

postV4MemoriesForgetMatching.description: Uses semantic search or explicit IDs to mass-forget memories matching a prompt or query

postV4MemoriesList.description: Lists active memory entries, version histories, and source document relations for a container tag

postV4Profile.description: Retrieves static and dynamic contextual profile facts for a specific container tag

postV4ProfileBuckets.description: Retrieves effective profile category bucket definitions for a given container tag.

postV4Search.description: Performs low-latency semantic and hybrid search across memories and document chunks
